asset_test.details: Application asks for asset verification such as a bank statement; the summary lists a bank statement as required. Asset testing is not required at NHSC-certified clinics (Greenfield, Hillsboro, Washington Courthouse).

how_to_apply: Call 855-275-7408 or (740) 779-8786; email FinancialCounselingTeam@adena.org; mail/return to Adena Health System, Financial Counselor, 272 Hospital Rd Suite 240, Chillicothe, OH 45601; fax 740-779-8257; www.adena.org
warnings: Policy conflicts: the Plain Language Summary says you cannot be a Medicaid recipient, and the policy requires applying for Medicaid and being denied, except at NHSC clinics.
The HCAP program (Ohio) is for income below 100% FPL with 100% discount; the CCP program is the hospital's own, so the 200% free care limit is for CCP.
Application window counts from the first follow-up notice for payment; HCAP applications are accepted for three years from date of service.
The policy covers multiple entities: ARMC, AGMC, APMC, AMG, AFMC; rules are stated to apply uniformly.
Plain Language Summary table labels the 301-400% band as 67% and the 101-200% band as 100%, and the summary states income must be below 400% FPL.
Insured patient eligibility is not clearly stated; policy refers to uninsured self-pay discount and Medicaid denial requirement.
